title: Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements Tariff of Holding Fees and Automatic Payment Discounts
content:
# Tariff of holding fees

Each plan of Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements charges a fee for holding the merchandise, expressed both as a flat amount and as a share of the merchandise price, and each states whether that fee is returned if the agreement is cancelled and what comes off it while automatic payment is in force.

| Plan | Flat holding fee (USD) | Holding fee as a share of the merchandise price | Holding fee returned on cancellation | Automatic payment offered | Amount off the holding fee while automatic payment is in force (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | 0.00 | 0 percent | yes | no | 0.00 |
| 90-Day Layaway | 15.00 | 1 percent | no | yes | 5.00 |
| 6-Month Layaway | 25.00 | 1.5 percent | no | yes | 10.00 |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | 45.00 | 2 percent | no | yes | 15.00 |
| Special Order Layaway | 35.00 | 1.5 percent | no | yes | 10.00 |
| Gift Registry Layaway | 30.00 | 1.5 percent | no | yes | 10.00 |

## Tariff notes

- The flat holding fee and the share of the merchandise price are the two figures from which the plan's fee for holding the merchandise is read.
- The 30-Day Hold Agreement charges nothing for holding the merchandise on either reading, and what it charges is returned on cancellation.
- Automatic payment is not offered on the 30-Day Hold Agreement. On every other plan it is offered, and while it is in force the holding fee is reduced by the amount shown for that plan.

## Questions the tariff answers

**Is the holding fee returned if the agreement is cancelled?** On the 30-Day Hold Agreement, yes. On the 90-Day Layaway, the 6-Month Layaway, the 12-Month Bridal Layaway, the Special Order Layaway and the Gift Registry Layaway, no.

**What is the automatic payment discount taken off?** The holding fee, by the flat amount shown for the plan, while automatic payment is in force.
